pristine.sourcePolicy: upstream test:types compiles the complete React adapter source

adapted.sourcePolicy: adapted test:types compiles the complete Octane adapter source

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/package/src; Octane probes import the package public entry
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid shapes on both sides

divergences.rule: Public adapter types keep framework-prefixed names on each side

notes: Public-API probes under type-probes/ and typetests/ are classified controls that keep one-for-one assertion inventories; they do not substitute for the upstream-suite source compiles declared in react-parity.json.
